story.title: Weather-ready garden reception
story.description: An 80-guest outdoor wedding in Richmond combining warm timber furniture, festoon lighting and a practical wet-weather marquee plan.

brief.title: A warm outdoor celebration with a practical weather plan
brief.description: The couple wanted an intimate garden atmosphere without risking comfort or logistics. The plan paired natural timber furniture with covered dining, layered lighting and a clear wet-weather fallback.

whatMadeItWork.title: Products and services working as one plan

layout.title: A clear layout, covered dining and an organised setup sequence
layout.description: One circulation route kept service practical while the lighting layers made the garden feel intimate after dark.
layout.takeaway: Practical takeaway: build the weather plan into the layout from the beginning.
